method: Injected-failure unit tests against the real production code paths (GenericIngestor._flush_pending/run, RunCoordinator.begin_chunk/commit_chunk/finalize_run) with fake store/backend adapters implementing the same contract real PostgresRunStore/ClickHouse/Qdrant/pgvector adapters do. No live database this session, so genuine PostgreSQL transaction-rollback-on-close semantics for point 10 are verified by code inspection rather than executed live.
invariants_checked_at_every_point: the failing/new run never becomes active
no other run's rows are deleted
resume/retry only cleans the same inactive run's chunk data before rewriting

points.label: Metadata write öncesi
points.note: decode/embed succeed, metadata write itself raises; zero backend write_chunk calls happen; chunk marked failed; old active run untouched

points.label: Metadata write sonrası
points.note: metadata rows land in the store but the chunk is still marked failed (not committed) because the coordinator only commits after ALL backend/dimension counts match; resume's begin_chunk cleanup removes the orphaned metadata rows via delete_inactive_metadata_chunk before redoing the chunk

points.label: İlk vector backend write öncesi
points.evidence: test_fault_1_and_3_failure_before_any_write_leaves_chunk_uncommitted (same injection point as #1 since metadata always writes first in _flush_pending)

points.label: İlk backend write sonrası
points.note: with two enabled backends, the first backend's rows are written and left in place (uncommitted-chunk state) when the second backend's write fails; begin_chunk's delete_inactive_chunk on retry is scoped per (run_id, chunk_index, dimension) per backend, so it correctly wipes the first backend's orphaned rows too

points.label: İlk dimension write sonrası
points.note: with two enabled dimensions on one backend, the first dimension's rows persist (uncommitted) when the second dimension's write fails

points.label: DB write batch ortasında
points.note: DB_WRITE_BATCH_SIZE=2 with 4 records forces two flushes per chunk; the first flush's rows are committed to the backend fake, the second flush's failure still fails the whole chunk

points.label: Chunk commit öncesi
points.note: RunCoordinator.commit_chunk raises on any backend:dimension row-count mismatch and marks the chunk failed rather than committed

points.label: Final row count kontrolünde
points.note: finalize_run checks metadata_count, duplicate_count, and every enabled backend:dimension count_run() against expected; any mismatch marks the run failed without touching dataset_active_runs

points.label: Active pointer değişiminden önce
points.note: activate() is only reached once every check passed; if activate() itself then raises, the fake store's active pointer is provably untouched

points.label: Active pointer transaction'ı sırasında
points.evidence: service/app/db/ingest_runs.py::PostgresRunStore.activate() - single with postgres.connection() as conn block, both the UPDATE ingest_runs...WHERE status='validating' and the INSERT...dataset_active_runs...ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE execute before one conn.commit(); app/db/postgres.py::connection() closes the connection in a finally without ever calling conn.commit() on the exception path
points.note: Real PostgreSQL/psycopg2 rolls back an open transaction when its connection is closed without a commit, so a failure between the two statements leaves neither applied. This specific guarantee comes from the database client library's standard behavior, not custom application rollback logic, and genuinely cannot be proven by a fake-store unit test - it requires a live PostgreSQL connection to exercise for real. Not run this session (no Docker daemon/live DB).

not_run_live.reason: No Docker daemon or live PostgreSQL/ClickHouse/Qdrant this session
not_run_live.required_command: docker compose --env-file .env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.gpu.yml exec -T api python -m app.ingestion.ingest --dataset /workspace/datasets/kurum.yaml --resume (interrupted mid-run via container kill, then resumed)
not_run_live.expected_environment: Healthy institution stack with an intentionally interrupted inactive run
